name: Should I convert my garage or build an addition?

mainEntity.name: Should I convert my garage or build an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a garage conversion and a home addition depends on your specific needs, budget, and property constraints. A garage conversion is generally more cost-effective and quicker because it utilizes an existing structure, foundation, and roof. It's ideal for adding square footage without expanding your home's footprint. A full addition offers more flexibility in terms of size and layout but is a larger investment and a longer project. Consider your space requirements, budget, and desired level of customization when making this choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage conversion is often more cost-effective and quicker, using existing structure. A home addition offers more design flexibility but costs more and takes longer.
